metadataRaw.title: 30 SECOND FIX: Instant Back & Shoulder Pain Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows effective exercises to help relieve back and shoulder pain FAST — even within 30 seconds.

These exercises work by stretching and strengthening key muscles that commonly cause pain in this area, including the rhomboids, trapezius, and levator scapulae.

Each exercise works a little differently, so go through them all and stick with the ones that give you the most relief.

Watch now and get quick, long-lasting back and shoulder pain relief!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:31 Seated Rhomboid Reach
2:35 Angel/Swimmers Combo
5:13 Figure 8
7:20 30-Second Relief Stretch
9:18 Liftoff (Strengthening)
